title: App keeps crashing randomly
body:
Let’s be honest. The interface and functionality of the app considering that it syncs across devices other than iPhone too, is great. Nevertheless, since I installed it about  a year ago(?) it keeps crashing randomly without obvious reason. Yes I am updating the app regularly and iPhone iOS. In general, it makes the iPhone hot which means that probably overuses CPU power once again without reason. 
If we put aside these dysfunctions, it still is a great cross platform solution. My will here is not to downrate the app.  Please have a look on the issue since it is also identified by many many users.
